eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Washoe, NV; Nevada; at 4:42 PM on AUG 8, 2026 Effective until 8:42 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Washoe County Emergency Management: WILDLAND FIRE in CA moving into Cold Springs. EVACUATE NOW. Evacuate point at NV Library. Watch for first responders. Check perimetermap.com and local media for updates.
